meadow.prompt: A sunny wildflower meadow with a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, surrounded by tall green grass, white clover and purple wildflowers, with oak trees in the background under a soft blue sky. A few honeybees drift in and out of the hive entrance. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

smoker_settle.prompt: A sunny wildflower meadow with a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, surrounded by green grass, white clover and purple wildflowers, with oak trees under a soft blue sky. Thin wisps of pale smoke drift past the hive as calm honeybees fly out in steady lines toward the flowers. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

smoker_angry.prompt: A wildflower meadow with a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, surrounded by green grass and purple wildflowers, with oak trees under a darkening sky. A dense, buzzing cloud of agitated honeybees swirls around the hive entrance. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

feed_sick.prompt: A faded meadow with a weathered white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, the grass dry and grey-brown and the wildflowers drooping, with bare oak trees under an overcast grey sky. A few slow honeybees crawl at the hive entrance. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

feed_recover.prompt: A meadow turning green again around a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, with fresh white clover and purple wildflowers opening and oak trees under a clearing blue sky. Honeybees return to the hive in steady streams. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

wasps_raid.prompt: A sunny wildflower meadow with a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, with oak trees under a soft blue sky. A crowd of yellow-and-black wasps hovers at the hive's wide open entrance while honeybees scatter around it. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

wasps_leave.prompt: A sunny wildflower meadow with a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, with oak trees under a soft blue sky. A row of guard honeybees stands shoulder to shoulder at the hive's narrow entrance, and a few yellow wasps fly away over the flowers. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

heat_stress.prompt: A wildflower meadow in a heat wave under a blazing white sun, with dry golden grass and heat shimmer rising around a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, and oak trees hazy in the background. Honeybees cluster in a thick beard on the front of the hive. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

heat_drink.prompt: A sunny wildflower meadow with a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, with oak trees under a soft blue sky. A shallow dish of water filled with pebbles sits beside the hive, honeybees land on the pebbles to drink, and others fan their wings at the hive entrance. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

whatif_fire.prompt: A meadow wildfire at dusk, with low orange flames and glowing embers spreading through the dry grass behind a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, and oak trees silhouetted against an orange sky. Thick grey smoke rises and bright embers drift through the air. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

fire_out.prompt: A meadow after a gentle rain, with patches of dark wet ash, thin white steam rising and fresh green shoots around a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, and oak trees under a clearing blue sky. Honeybees fly back to the hive entrance. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

whatif_rain.prompt: Steady rain falls on a green wildflower meadow with a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, with oak trees under a soft grey sky. Puddles shine in the grass and raindrops bead on the hive roof while honeybees rest inside the entrance. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

whatif_flowers.prompt: A wildflower meadow bursting with thick drifts of white clover and purple wildflowers around a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, with oak trees under a bright blue sky. Dozens of honeybees move from blossom to blossom in warm sunlight. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

whatif_spray.prompt: A wildflower meadow with a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, with oak trees under a hazy yellow sky. A fine white mist of pesticide spray drifts across the meadow from a tractor at the far edge and settles on the flowers. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

whatif_winter.prompt: Fresh snow covers a quiet meadow and the roof of a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, with frosted oak trees under a pale winter sky. A faint warm glow shows at the hive entrance. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

whatif_custom.prompt: A sunny wildflower meadow with a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, with oak trees under a soft blue sky. A soft golden shimmer ripples through the grass and the air around the hive as the meadow begins to change. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

full_bloom.prompt: A meadow in full bloom, with clover, purple salvia, lavender and sunflowers filling every inch around a white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center, and oak trees glowing in golden afternoon light. Hundreds of honeybees stream out of the hive and across the flowers. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.

moon.prompt: The meadow has turned into the grey cratered surface of the Moon, with a lone white wooden beehive on a low stand in the center of the fine grey dust. The blue and white Earth rises over the horizon into a black sky full of stars. Wide shot, eye-level, static camera, deep depth of field.
